liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **High Time** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this one of the greatest High Time performances they have ever heard; Reviewer describes the performance as one for the ages with high energy [28][30]
- **Loser** (1 review): Reviewer notes Jerry barks out the lyrics during this specific performance [35]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Jerry used distinct guitar runs and a quiet, clean vocal tone in this performance [34]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-11-07.nak300.andrewf.127711.flac2448** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 134 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: New source offers fantastic sound quality, highlighting the drum breakouts from 1985 [37]
- **gd1985-11-07.148632.fob.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 21 songs; 139 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1985-11-07.schoeps.oade.22798.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 138 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [7]
- **gd1985-11-07.sbd.miller.88727.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 130 min; rated 4/5 by 5 [10]. Said about its sound: Soundboard recording described as having an intense East Coast rocket fuel feel [28]
- **gd1985-11-07.fob-beyerm88.connor.30554.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 126 min; rated 1.33/5 by 3 [16]

## Around the show

- Reviewer describes the venue as haunted, referencing a Hannah Montana costume change incident [26]
- Attendees visited the Moosewood Cookbook location and saw local band Holy Smoke before the show [29]
- General admission crowd left the smaller venue dripping in sweat into the cold air [30]
- Bobby and Brent joined the band for the encore performance of this song [34]
- Reviewer preferred Van Halen's version over the Dead's, though still enjoying the show [27]
- Reviewer states every Grateful Dead show played in Rochester is worthy [33]
- Reviewer ranks this performance alongside Saratoga and Richmond as yearly favorites [35]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-11-07.nak300.andrewf.127711.flac2448**: taped by Andrew F.; transferred by Andrew F.; source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90s, with no Dolby. Set up to the right (stage left) of the SBD. [1]. Also: Patches applied from ID-114676 for Cumberland Blues and Space transitions [1]
- **gd1985-11-07.148632.fob.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [5]. Also: Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source supplied patches for Cumberland Blues and Space [5]
- **gd1985-11-07.schoeps.oade.22798.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by dwonk; source: Schoeps CMC441 (TS, 90deg, 17cm) > Oade M118 > Oade modSONY PCM-F1 [7]. Also: Doug Oade performed DSP using Waves plugins; dwonk handled tracking and fades [7]
- **gd1985-11-07.sbd.miller.88727.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat D [10]. Also: Schoeps CMC4/MK41 to Oade M118 chain supplied specific audio patches [10]
- **gd1985-11-07.fob-beyerm88.connor.30554.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Charlie Connor; transferred by Charlie Connor; source: FOB AUD>Beyer Dynamic M88's>Sony TCD5M(CM Maxell Mx 90) [16]. Also: File download matches the provided MD5 checksum for verification purposes [32]
